card: This PR isolates all legacy wallet loading and migration code into a dedicated wallet/legacy directory and wallet::legacy_migration namespace, introducing a LegacyWallet subclass of CWallet. Moving legacy-specific components like LegacyDataSPKM and ReorderTransactions out of the main wallet structures prevents descriptor wallet logic from accidentally invoking obsolete paths. It also skips copying legacy records during migration, allowing unused record deletion functions to be completely removed from CWallet and WalletBatch. Depends on #36823.
changed_since_previous: The earlier description referenced atomic SQLite creation in temporary directories, stale journal detection, and exception rollback logic which belonged to merged predecessor PR #34909. This version focuses strictly on isolating legacy code into `wallet/legacy`, namespacing under `wallet::legacy_migration`, subclassing `LegacyWallet`, and dropping unused record removal methods via skipping records during migration.
evidence: PR description: 'Now that we no longer support loading legacy wallets, there is no reason to keep any of the legacy wallet loading and migration code in the main wallet objects. Having this co-mingling of never-to-be-changed legacy wallet code and new descriptor wallet code makes it difficult to implement new things into the wallet.'

Commit 4c927aa884: 'Put all legacy wallet migration related code into a custom namespace to clearly delineate which functions are migration and which are not, and to prevent accidentally calling into migration functions from outside of migration.'
problem: Legacy wallet loading and migration code is co-mingled with descriptor wallet code across core wallet classes like `CWallet`, despite legacy wallets no longer being loadable for normal operations. This clutter complicates descriptor wallet maintenance and risks accidental calls to legacy routines.

risk.why: Mistakes in legacy loading, record copying, or migration could cause wallet migration to fail or produce corrupted descriptor wallets from legacy data.

scope_notes: Large mechanical refactoring: extracts `LegacyDataSPKM` and legacy loading code into `src/wallet/legacy/` (`spkm.cpp`, `load.cpp`, `migration.cpp`, `bdbro.cpp`).
summary: Isolates legacy wallet loading and migration routines into a dedicated `wallet/legacy/` directory under a `wallet::legacy_migration` namespace, introducing a `LegacyWallet` subclass of `CWallet`. Removes unused erase functions (`RemoveTxs`, `EraseTx`, `EraseRecords`, `DeleteRecordsWithDB`) by skipping legacy records during migration instead of copying and erasing them.
